title: Handyman Invoice Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Bill small jobs from your browser: hourly labor, minimum charge, materials markup. No sign-up. PDF, Word and Excel files, with US prices and license limits.
lede_html: List each small job in the form and get a handyman invoice as a PDF, Word or Excel file. You do not sign up. The sample is a half-day punch list. Change it to your work.

sample.pay: Zelle or check to Tom Reyes
sample.terms: Materials at cost plus 15%. Receipts on request.

must_show.heading: What to show on a handyman invoice
must_show.intro_html: A handyman invoice lists small tasks clearly, shows how you bill time and material, and states your license status where a state asks.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters on small jobs

A short note on what you fixed answers later questions.

line_items.heading: Handyman line items, with ranges from the sources
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.
line_items.after_html: For scale: general maintenance and repair workers had median pay of $23.84 per hour in May 2025 (BLS). Self-employed rates also cover your tools, van and insurance.

rules.heading: Handyman rules that touch the invoice

items.title: California: the $1,000 line
items.html: Since 1 January 2025, California exempts minor work up to $1,000 from a contractor license. The work cannot need a permit, and the unlicensed person cannot employ anyone on the project.

items.title: California: say so in ads
items.html: An unlicensed person there may advertise for work up to $1,000 only if the ad says the person is not licensed. You can print the same line on the invoice.

items.title: Florida: casual, minor work
items.html: Florida exempts casual, minor or inconsequential work under $2,500 total from 489.103's contractor licensing part. Larger jobs, split contracts and anyone who advertises as a contractor do not qualify.

faq.q: Should I charge by the hour or by the job?
faq.a: Use the hour for mixed lists and the job for tasks that you know well. The form takes both: set the unit field to hour or job.

faq.q: How do I show a minimum charge?
faq.a: Add a line named Minimum service charge. Then the customer sees why a 20-minute visit costs more than 20 minutes of your rate.

faq.q: Do I need sales tax on a handyman invoice?
faq.a: Leave the rate empty when you do not charge it. Ask your state revenue office if you are not sure.

faq.q: What goes in the license field when I do not have one?
faq.a: Do not write a number that you do not hold. Write your exemption, or leave the field empty if your state does not ask for one.
